analytical_dimensions.description:
Cases, boundaries and comparable objects. Identify the unit before comparing it. Separate a paper, a case and an actor inside a case; keep nested cases explicit. Choose criteria because they answer a shared question and the sources can speak to them. Treat approaches as cases when the material is conceptual, without pretending they are empirical countries or successive stages.
Instrument identity precedes chronology. In the supplied AUKUS article, the June 2023 Eximbank statutory-capital proposal and the December 2023 Enforcement Decree of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act are separately named and juxtaposed, without an explicit identity link. Retain separate proposal and decree findings and state identity unresolved; do not call them proposed/effective stages of the same amendment, or say that the December decree enacted the June Eximbank proposal. December's defence-export effect is expressed as potential. More generally, shared jurisdiction, topic or neighboring sentences do not identify two instruments; quote an explicit identity predicate before merging their stages. Apply this distinction in the actual case matrix and every final summary.
probing_questions: What case or approach does this source actually document, which actors belong to it, and what object, place and time does it cover? Distinguish a source from the cases within it.

What shared reader question could this case answer, and which comparison criteria does the source justify? Preserve supplied reader criteria; label analyst-proposed criteria and explain their relevance.
Which names denote the same entity and which similar names denote different entities, institutional levels or objects? What evidence warrants alignment?

analytical_dimensions.description:
Answers on candidate common criteria. Inventory answers that can become matrix cells. Preserve the case actor, instrument, mechanism and evidential status; do not convert the source's interpretation into an independently observed outcome. Copy units and denominators with values. Supply the exact answer, not a generic synopsis; leave unanswerable criteria in the coverage report. A causal or reactive status belongs only to the case the source attributes it to. Parallel infrastructure supports duplication, not transfer of chronology or causation. Quote the attributing sentence per case; keep another case unclassified when no sentence attributes that status to it.
For parallel projects, inspect the named projects separately and retain positive findings for both identities and statuses. If PEACE and EMA occur, read their passages and the conclusion, quote the distinct chronology and the sentence assigning reaction or succession, and include their evidenced distinction in the final comparison. Shared routes do not transfer a cause from one cable to another, and omitting both does not resolve the attribution question. For conceptual comparisons, inspect formal/official versus effective/informal practice before calling a cell missing; where Technique is supplied, check management's official work organization and workers' informal organization on the same material basis. Preserve the actual scope of that contrast.
For broken-word source text, copy from raw source bytes rather than reconstructing the word. Preserve the space before a line-end hyphen, the hyphen and newline: be - followed by newline came must not become became or be- followed by newline came. Use a short complete predicate span and a separate identity/ownership span, not one long sentence reconstructed across columns or furniture. A matching prefix is inadequate if it loses the date or operative predicate. For the supplied subsea article, a complete short PEACE status packet is the literal span “One such effort is the PEACE cable, which be -
came operational in 2022.” Reinspect and copy that span from the supplied source; keep ownership/routes in separate anchors. Retain the separate positive PEACE operational chronology and EMA reported reactive development in the final comparison; omission of both or substitution of ownership alone does not answer the required status distinction. EMA's reported reaction to SeaMeWe-6 exclusion must never be transferred to PEACE. Short source spans for each project must carry its own predicate. Instrument identity precedes chronology. Apply this distinction in the actual case matrix and every final summary.
probing_questions: On each justified candidate criterion, what answer does this case supply, with its mechanism, evidence and qualification? Use the criterion as a question, not a topic label.

What are the relevant actors, instruments, constraints and reported consequences, or the conceptual equivalents if the case is an approach? Distinguish a stated aim, a mechanism and a demonstrated result.

Where is the value quantitative, qualitative, binary or ordinal, and what definition, denominator, date or evaluative standard makes that value meaningful? Do not create a ranking without supplied criteria.
Which distinct parallel projects have separately stated dates and causal/reactive status, and which named passage supports each attribution?

probing_questions: What in this source qualifies or defeats a proposed common pattern, and which case detail would a uniform template erase?
Which cultural or institutional assumptions and translation choices limit equivalence? Does a common word have a different local meaning or referent?

Which candidate criteria cannot be answered from the inspected passages, and why: not supplied, insufficient evidence, or incommensurable object, time, unit or meaning? State inspected sections and coverage; a missing extraction is not silence.
Does the source positively contrast formal or official rules with effective or informal practice, even under the same material conditions, before a candidate comparison cell is called missing?

analytical_dimensions.description:

Keep exceptions and unfilled cells visible rather than imputing values. Every positive cross-source relation needs an anchor from every source it covers; two distinct keys are the minimum. Per-document inventories permit only provisional coverage claims until the corpus critic inspects the sources.

Preserve corpus ancestry and both distinct source keys; do not disguise a corpus descendant as a one-source finding. probing_questions: Which common questions are justified by the supplied case inventories? Explain alignment, keeping a source-to-case map when a source contains several cases or several sources describe one case.
For each common criterion, what does each case answer, with its source identity and scope? Retain every case and every missing, insufficient or incommensurable cell in the table.
Which similarities, differences, clusters or outliers survive equivalent definitions and explicit exceptions? Test the strongest proposed common pattern against the most inconvenient case.
What comparison is supportable within this collection, and which evaluative ranking or universal claim remains unlicensed by the supplied criteria and coverage?

capabilities.description: The justified case by criterion matrix

depth_levels.description: One provisional corpus reading on the strong tier.
One corpus reading, a source and cell check, then reconciliation of the tables with the applied findings.
Per-document inventories, corpus relations, source verification and one integrated reading; natural mode for desk-ready corpus work.

problematique:
Compare supplied cases on justified common questions. The unit may be a country, policy, institution, option or conceptual approach, but a source is not automatically one case. The product is a case by criterion matrix with attributed evidence, explicit missing and incommensurable cells, supported contrasts and exceptions. Comparison criteria must answer the shared inquiry; evaluative rankings require reader criteria. Cultural context and translation may limit equivalence; universal patterns cannot exceed the supplied coverage.

Evidence must travel with the claim. One finding carries one consequential answer, or a tightly linked answer and its qualification. Select exact spans of about 80–160 characters each, below 200, retaining the named subject, complete predicate, attribution, negation and conditional force. Use anchor-b/doc-b and further pairs for additional exact spans, including from the same document; never concatenate separated source text into one quote. Preserve literal bracketed letters, hyphens and line breaks; choose separate spans around page headers. A quotation ending mid-word, at a conjunction, or before its essential object cannot carry the completed claim. Narrow the finding or add evidence. Two spans from one source remain single-source evidence; a corpus relation needs distinct source keys.
